access_tokens_revocation_check.name: access_tokens_revocation_check
access_tokens_revocation_check.value: ("application_access_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("application_access_tokens"."revoke_reason" IS NULL) AND ("application_access_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("application_access_tokens"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL)

storage_write_attempts_version_check.name: storage_write_attempts_version_check
storage_write_attempts_version_check.value: ("storage_write_attempts"."state" = 'CONFIRMED') = ("storage_write_attempts"."version_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("storage_write_attempts"."version_id" IS NULL OR char_length("storage_write_attempts"."version_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

app_doc_files_version_check.name: app_doc_files_version_check
app_doc_files_version_check.value: ("application_document_files"."status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUPERSEDED', 'REMOVED')) = ("application_document_files"."version_number" IS NOT NULL) AND ("application_document_files"."version_number" IS NULL OR "application_document_files"."version_number" >= 1)

app_doc_files_validated_metadata_check.name: app_doc_files_validated_metadata_check
app_doc_files_validated_metadata_check.value: NOT ("application_document_files"."status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUPERSEDED', 'REMOVED')) OR ("application_document_files"."size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "application_document_files"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "application_document_files"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

app_doc_files_ended_by_check.name: app_doc_files_ended_by_check
app_doc_files_ended_by_check.value: "application_document_files"."ended_by_actor_type" IN ('USER', 'CUSTOMER') AND ("application_document_files"."ended_by_actor_type" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'USER') = ("application_document_files"."ended_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

document_comments_idempotency_check.name: document_comments_idempotency_check
document_comments_idempotency_check.value: ("document_comments"."idempotency_key" IS NULL) = ("document_comments"."payload_hash" IS NULL) AND ("document_comments"."payload_hash" IS NULL OR "document_comments"."payload_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

document_reviews_message_check.name: document_reviews_message_check
document_reviews_message_check.value: ("document_reviews"."decision" <> 'REVISION_REQUIRED' OR ("document_reviews"."customer_message" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("document_reviews"."customer_message") BETWEEN 10 AND 1000)) AND ("document_reviews"."customer_message" IS NULL OR char_length("document_reviews"."customer_message") <= 1000)

app_internal_notes_idempotency_check.name: app_internal_notes_idempotency_check
app_internal_notes_idempotency_check.value: ("application_internal_notes"."idempotency_key" IS NULL) = ("application_internal_notes"."payload_hash" IS NULL) AND ("application_internal_notes"."payload_hash" IS NULL OR "application_internal_notes"."payload_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

app_status_history_reason_check.name: app_status_history_reason_check
app_status_history_reason_check.value: (NOT ("application_status_history"."transition_code" IN ('CANCEL', 'REOPEN_CANCELLED', 'REOPEN_COMPLETED', 'REVERT_TO_DOCUMENTS_APPROVED', 'REVERT_TO_REVIEW', 'REVERT_FOR_REVISION')) OR ("application_status_history"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("application_status_history"."reason")) >= 1)) AND ("application_status_history"."reason" IS NULL OR char_length("application_status_history"."reason") <= 1000)
